Description
Tests behavior of NV2A fixed-function fog modes and generation modes.
Suite class def
src/tests/fog_tests.h

AFF-exp-planar

Exponential planar fog with fixed-function vertex processing. Four white triangles fade exponentially into reddish-purple fog as depth increases.

AFF-exp2-planar

Exponential squared planar fog with fixed-function vertex processing. Four white triangles fade into reddish-purple fog with quadratic depth falloff.

AFF-exp2_abs-planar

Exponential squared absolute-value planar fog with fixed-function vertex processing.

AFF-exp_abs-planar

Exponential absolute-value planar fog with fixed-function vertex processing.

AFF-linear-planar

Linear planar fog with fixed-function vertex processing. Four white triangles fade into reddish-purple fog as depth increases.

AFF-linear_abs-planar

Linear absolute-value planar fog with fixed-function vertex processing.
